ticket_shown_to_model.title: Subscription Manager overcharging users and ignoring refunds (APAC)
ticket_shown_to_model.description: Our Subscription Manager in the APAC production region is overcharging customers and not reflecting recent refunds. This high-impact issue affects 559 users. We have verified that refund transactions were processed upstream, but the Subscription Manager continues to bill the full amount. This is causing significant financial and support overhead. Please assist in correcting the billing state.

parsed.summary: The Subscription Manager in the APAC production region is overcharging customers and not reflecting recent refunds, affecting 559 users. The issue is likely related to a billing or commerce issue, but the root cause is unclear.
